title: For Families: The Closing Amount on an Independent Living Move-Out
content:
A residency under a notice of termination of the Independent Living Residency Agreement may be settled before the apartment is surrendered by one closing payment drawn as a one-time ACH payment, and the closing amount is set as follows.

## The closing amount

The closing amount is the move-out carpet cleaning fee charged once when the apartment is vacated and carried on the final statement, which is the carpet cleaning fee of the apartment type, rounded to the cent half up.

## What families can expect

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| What is the closing amount made of? | The move-out carpet cleaning fee of the apartment type |
| Where is that fee shown? | On the final statement, as the fee charged once when the apartment is vacated |
| How is it paid? | One closing payment, a one-time ACH draft |
| When can it be paid? | While the residency is under a notice of termination, before the apartment is surrendered |

## Hypothetical illustration

For an apartment type whose carpet cleaning fee were 200.00, the closing amount would be 200.00, the move-out carpet cleaning fee to be charged when the apartment is vacated.
